finding: During TASK-RFT-0042, the task direction lock allowed `packages/cli/src/commands/team/legacy/**/*.ts`, but the pre-commit hook still flagged newly staged files under that path as `ATM_TASK_DIRECTION_SCOPE_DRIFT` until each file was added explicitly with `tasks scope add`.
expectedBehavior: Direction-lock scope matching should apply the same glob semantics across task claim, scope amendment, taskflow pre-close, and pre-commit staging checks so new files under an allowed recursive path do not require redundant explicit amendments.
evidenceOrRepro: The historical failure is no longer reproducible against the current source. `node --strip-types tests/cli/taskflow-scope-untracked-glob.test.ts` passed matcher parity and confirmed a newly created direct child under `packages/cli/src/commands/next/playbook-projection/**/*.ts` is included in the taskflow commit bundle; `node --strip-types tests/cli/work-admission-ticket-scope-glob-parity.test.ts` passed the canonical work-admission matcher across write/stage/commit/close/push. The shared matcher repair is present in commit `d66c3b2de`.
followUp: Retain the glob-parity regressions. Reopen only if a new direction-lock scope form diverges between pre-commit, taskflow bundle assembly, and work-admission validation.
